```{r setup, include=FALSE}
start_date <- as.Date(params$start_date)
end_date <- as.Date(params$end_date)
snapshot_date <- as.Date(params$snapshot_date)

stopifnot(
  !is.na(start_date),
  !is.na(end_date),
  !is.na(snapshot_date),
  start_date <= end_date
)

history_year_breaks <- function(by = 1L) {
  as.Date(paste0(seq(as.integer(format(start_date, "%Y")),
                    as.integer(format(end_date, "%Y")), by = by), "-07-01"))
}

pct_difference <- function(registered, ons) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(ons) | ons == 0,
    NA_real_,
    100 * (registered - ons) / ons
  )
}

# Build the pound sign at render time to avoid escaped Unicode text in charts.
gbp_symbol <- intToUtf8(163)

comparison_bar <- function(
  data,
  category,
  title,
  subtitle,
  y_title = NULL,
  fixed_fill = NULL
) {
  category_quo <- rlang::enquo(category)

  p <- ggplot(
    data,
    aes(
      x = Pct_Difference,
      y = !!category_quo
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.5)

  if (is.null(fixed_fill)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_col(aes(fill = Pct_Difference), width = 0.7) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "#B2182B",
        mid = "#F2F2F2",
        high = "#2166AC",
        midpoint = 0,
        guide = "none"
      )
  } else {
    p <- p + geom_col(fill = fixed_fill, width = 0.7)
  }

  p +
    geom_text(
    colour = "grey20",
      aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Pct_Difference)),
      hjust = ifelse(data$Pct_Difference >= 0, -0.12, 1.12),
      size = 3.7
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.16, 0.18))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Percentage difference from ONS",
      y = y_title,
      caption = "Percentage difference = (registered patients − ONS estimate) / ONS estimate × 100."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 30, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}


# HTML tables start closed; document outputs retain ordinary visible tables.
report_table <- function(x, caption = NULL, ...) {
  if (!knitr::is_html_output()) {
    return(knitr::kable(x, caption = caption, ...))
  }
  summary <- if (is.null(caption)) "View table" else paste("View table:", caption)
  summary <- gsub("&", "&amp;", summary, fixed = TRUE)
  summary <- gsub("<", "&lt;", summary, fixed = TRUE)
  summary <- gsub(">", "&gt;", summary, fixed = TRUE)
  table_html <- paste(
    knitr::kable(x, format = "html", caption = caption, ...),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
  knitr::asis_output(paste0(
    "\n<details class=\"report-table\"><summary>", summary, "</summary>\n",
    "<div class=\"report-table-scroll\">\n", table_html,
    "\n</div>\n</details>\n"
  ))
}

source("18_Export_Chart_Data.R")
chart_csv <- new_chart_csv_exporter(params$chart_data_dir)

# Source labels are embedded in figures, so exported charts retain provenance.
label_chart <- function(plot, source, inputs = NULL) {
  chart_id <- knitr::opts_current$get("label")
  chart_rows <- plot$data
  if (inherits(chart_rows, "sf")) chart_rows <- sf::st_drop_geometry(chart_rows)
  payment_date <- if (grepl("payment", chart_id) &&
                      exists("payment_snapshot_date", inherits = TRUE)) {
    as.Date(payment_snapshot_date)
  } else as.Date(NA)
  chart_csv$write(chart_id, chart_rows, source,
    inputs = if (is.null(inputs)) "" else inputs,
    reference_date = snapshot_date, payment_date = payment_date,
    measure = if (is.null(plot$labels$y)) "" else as.character(plot$labels$y))
  source_text <- paste0("Registration data: ", source,
                        ". ONS: English LSOA population estimates.")
  if (!is.null(inputs)) source_text <- paste(source_text, inputs)
  existing_caption <- plot$labels$caption
  caption_lines <- vapply(c(source_text, existing_caption), function(x) {
    paste(strwrap(x, width = 105), collapse = "\n")
  }, character(1))
  plot + labs(caption = paste(caption_lines, collapse = "\n")) +
    theme(plot.caption = element_text(colour = "grey20", hjust = 0, size = 9))
}

first_matching_column <- function(data, exact = character(), regex = NULL) {
  nm <- names(data)

  exact_match <- exact[exact %in% nm]
  if (length(exact_match) > 0) {
    return(exact_match[[1]])
  }

  if (!is.null(regex)) {
    regex_match <- nm[grepl(regex, nm, ignore.case = TRUE)]
    if (length(regex_match) > 0) {
      return(regex_match[[1]])
    }
  }

  NA_character_
}
```

```{r prepare-analysis-data, include=FALSE}
age_levels <- c("0-19", "20-39", "40-59", "60+")

national_time_series <- bind_rows(national_registered, national_ons)

demographic_time_series <- full_join(
  practice_registered_demographic_time_series,
  ons_demographic_time_series,
  by = c("Period", "Sex", "Age_Band")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Age_Band = factor(Age_Band, levels = age_levels),
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    Pct_Difference = pct_difference(Registered, ONS)
  )

sum_if_available <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

age_time_series <- demographic_time_series %>%
  group_by(Period, Age_Band, Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    Registered = sum_if_available(Registered),
    ONS = sum_if_available(ONS),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Registered, ONS),
    names_to = "Source",
    values_to = "Population"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Source = recode(
      Source,
      Registered = "Registered patients",
      ONS = "ONS population estimate"
    )
  )

ons_sex_time_series <- ons_demographic_time_series %>%
  group_by(Period, Sex) %>%
  summarise(ONS = sum_if_available(ONS), .groups = "drop")

sex_comparison <- full_join(
  practice_registered_demographic_time_series %>%
    group_by(Period, Sex) %>%
    summarise(Registered = sum_if_available(Registered), .groups = "drop"),
  ons_sex_time_series, by = c("Period", "Sex")
) %>% mutate(Pct_Difference = pct_difference(Registered, ONS))

sex_time_series <- sex_comparison %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Registered, ONS),
    names_to = "Source",
    values_to = "Population"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Source = recode(
      Source,
      Registered = "Registered patients",
      ONS = "ONS population estimate"
    )
  )

national_snapshot <- national_time_series %>%
  filter(Period == snapshot_date) %>%
  select(Source, Population) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Source, values_from = Population) %>%
  transmute(
    Geography = "England",
    Registered = `Registered patients`,
    ONS = `ONS population estimate`,
    Pct_Difference = pct_difference(Registered, ONS)
  )

if (nrow(national_snapshot) != 1L ||
    any(!is.finite(c(national_snapshot$Registered, national_snapshot$ONS)))) {
  stop("Both practice registrations and English ONS estimates are required at the selected snapshot.")
}

age_sex_snapshot <- demographic_time_series %>%
  filter(Period == snapshot_date) %>%
  mutate(Raw_Difference = Registered - ONS)

age_snapshot <- age_sex_snapshot %>%
  group_by(Age_Band) %>%
  summarise(
    Registered = sum(Registered, na.rm = TRUE),
    ONS = sum(ONS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Pct_Difference = pct_difference(Registered, ONS))

sex_snapshot <- sex_comparison %>%
  filter(Period == snapshot_date) %>%
  group_by(Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    Registered = sum(Registered, na.rm = TRUE),
    ONS = sum(ONS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Pct_Difference = pct_difference(Registered, ONS))

lsoa_july_all <- full_join(
  lsoa_registered_july,
  lsoa_ons_july,
  by = c("LSOA_Code", "Period")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Registered = replace_na(Registered, 0),
    ONS = replace_na(ONS, 0),
    Raw_Difference = Registered - ONS,
    Pct_Difference = pct_difference(Registered, ONS)
  )

# Explicit England-resident subset for every LSOA-derived analysis.
lsoa_july_england <- lsoa_july_all %>%
  filter(grepl("^E01", LSOA_Code))

# Quantify registered patients excluded from the England-resident LSOA subset.
non_england_registered_snapshot <- lsoa_registered_july %>%
  filter(
    Period == snapshot_date,
    !grepl("^E01", LSOA_Code)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Residence_Group = case_when(
      grepl("^W0", LSOA_Code) ~ "Wales",
      TRUE ~ "Other non-English LSOA"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Residence_Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Registered = sum(Registered, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

registered_removed_wales <- non_england_registered_snapshot %>%
  filter(Residence_Group == "Wales") %>%
  summarise(Registered = sum(Registered, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(Registered)

registered_removed_other <- non_england_registered_snapshot %>%
  filter(Residence_Group == "Other non-English LSOA") %>%
  summarise(Registered = sum(Registered, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(Registered)

registered_removed_non_england <-
  registered_removed_wales + registered_removed_other

lsoa_registered_snapshot_total <- lsoa_registered_july %>%
  filter(Period == snapshot_date) %>%
  summarise(Registered = sum(Registered, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(Registered)

registered_removed_non_england_pct <-
  100 * registered_removed_non_england / lsoa_registered_snapshot_total

if (nrow(anti_join(
  lsoa_july_england, nhser_lookup, by = c("LSOA_Code" = "LSOA21CD")
)) > 0) {
  stop("Some English LSOAs are missing from the April 2026 geography lookup.")
}

lsoa_july_geography <- lsoa_july_england %>%
  inner_join(nhser_lookup, by = c("LSOA_Code" = "LSOA21CD"))

registration_coverage <- summarise_registration_coverage(
  national_registered, lsoa_registered_july, imd_lookup, snapshot_date
)

imd_july <- lsoa_july_england %>%
  inner_join(
    imd_lookup %>% mutate(
      IMD_Decile = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(IMD_Decile)))
    ),
    by = "LSOA_Code"
  ) %>%
  filter(IMD_Decile %in% 1:10) %>%
  group_by(Period, IMD_Decile) %>%
  summarise(
    Registered = sum(Registered, na.rm = TRUE),
    ONS = sum(ONS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Raw_Difference = Registered - ONS,
    Pct_Difference = pct_difference(Registered, ONS),
    IMD_Label = factor(
      IMD_Decile,
      levels = 10:1,
      labels = c(
        "10 (Least deprived)", "9", "8", "7", "6",
        "5", "4", "3", "2", "1 (Most deprived)"
      )
    )
  )

region_july <- lsoa_july_geography %>%
  group_by(Period, NHSER26CD, NHSER26NM) %>%
  summarise(
    Registered = sum(Registered, na.rm = TRUE),
    ONS = sum(ONS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Raw_Difference = Registered - ONS,
    Pct_Difference = pct_difference(Registered, ONS)
  )

icb_july <- lsoa_july_geography %>%
  group_by(Period, ICB26CD, ICB26NM) %>%
  summarise(
    Registered = sum(Registered, na.rm = TRUE),
    ONS = sum(ONS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Raw_Difference = Registered - ONS,
    Pct_Difference = pct_difference(Registered, ONS)
  )

imd_snapshot <- imd_july %>% filter(Period == snapshot_date)
if (abs(sum(imd_snapshot$Registered) - registration_coverage$imd_patients) > 0.5) {
  stop("The deprivation analysis does not reconcile with the opening coverage summary.")
}
region_snapshot <- region_july %>% filter(Period == snapshot_date)
icb_snapshot <- icb_july %>% filter(Period == snapshot_date)

required_practice_lookup_cols <- c("Practice_Code", "NHS_Region")
missing_region_lookup_cols <- setdiff(
  required_practice_lookup_cols,
  names(practice_region_lookup)
)

if (length(missing_region_lookup_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "practice_region_lookup is missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_region_lookup_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

required_icb_lookup_cols <- c("Practice_Code", "ICB_Key", "ICB")
missing_icb_lookup_cols <- setdiff(
  required_icb_lookup_cols,
  names(practice_icb_lookup)
)

if (length(missing_icb_lookup_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "practice_icb_lookup is missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_icb_lookup_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (nrow(practice_icb_lookup) == 0) {
  stop(
    "The practice-to-ICB lookup is empty. Check the practice ICB fields ",
    "in payments2425.csv and 10_Get_Practice_Region_Lookup.R."
  )
}
# Registrations follow practice assignment; ONS continues to follow residence.
# A practice must map to at most one geography to prevent duplicate counting.
if (anyDuplicated(practice_region_lookup$Practice_Code) ||
    anyDuplicated(practice_icb_lookup$Practice_Code)) {
  stop("Practice geography lookups contain duplicate practice codes.")
}
practice_region_registered <- practice_registered_snapshot %>%
  inner_join(practice_region_lookup, by = "Practice_Code") %>%
  group_by(NHS_Region) %>%
  summarise(Registered = sum(Registered), .groups = "drop")

practice_icb_registered <- practice_registered_snapshot %>%
  inner_join(practice_icb_lookup, by = "Practice_Code") %>%
  group_by(ICB_Key, ICB) %>%
  summarise(Registered = sum(Registered), .groups = "drop")

# Population comparison charts retain residence-based LSOA registrations.
region_ons_keys <- region_snapshot %>%
  mutate(NHS_Region = normalise_region_name(NHSER26NM))
if (nrow(anti_join(practice_region_registered, region_ons_keys, by = "NHS_Region")) ||
    nrow(anti_join(practice_icb_registered, icb_snapshot,
                   by = c("ICB_Key" = "ICB26CD")))) {
  stop("A practice-assigned geography has no matching ONS population geography.")
}

registered_unassigned_region <- national_snapshot$Registered -
  sum(practice_region_registered$Registered)
registered_unassigned_icb <- national_snapshot$Registered -
  sum(practice_icb_registered$Registered)
for (local in list(region_snapshot, icb_snapshot)) {
  if (any(!is.finite(local$Registered)) ||
      abs(sum(local$Registered) - sum(lsoa_july_england$Registered)) > 0.5 ||
      abs(sum(local$ONS) - national_snapshot$ONS) > 0.5) {
    stop("Geographic LSOA comparison totals do not reconcile with their sources.")
  }
}
if (registered_unassigned_region < -0.5 || registered_unassigned_icb < -0.5) {
  stop("Assigned practice registrations exceed the national practice source.")
}
```

# Dataset Disparities

For `r format(snapshot_date, "%d %B %Y")` data, the practice-level registered patients data contains `r scales::comma(registration_coverage$practice_total)` registered patients, compared with `r scales::comma(registration_coverage$lsoa_total)` in the LSOA-level registered patients’ data before any filtering or linkage. The LSOA source contains `r scales::comma(abs(registration_coverage$practice_total - registration_coverage$lsoa_total))` `r ifelse(registration_coverage$lsoa_total <= registration_coverage$practice_total, "fewer", "more")` registrations than the practice-level total. [NHS England reported processing issues in the July 2024 LSOA release](https://digital.nhs.uk/data-and-information/publications/statistical/patients-registered-at-a-gp-practice/july-2024) which led to this difference.

The LSOA extract also includes `r scales::comma(registration_coverage$welsh_patients)` registered patients in `r scales::comma(registration_coverage$welsh_lsoa_count)` Welsh LSOAs. Another `r scales::comma(registration_coverage$other_patients)` registrations have an unknown or other residence code and are also excluded from the LSOA comparison dataset, leaving `r scales::comma(registration_coverage$english_patients)` registrations in the English LSOAs dataset used for IMD, regional and ICB population comparisons. Welsh LSOAs have no English IMD. English registrations without a valid IMD decile exclude another `r scales::comma(registration_coverage$english_patients_without_imd)` patients from the IMD comparison.

IMD, regional and ICB population comparisons use residence-based LSOA registrations. The new deprivation trends also use LSOA data. All other registration charts and tables, including FTE and funding analyses, use practice-level registrations. Practice registrations include patients of English GP practices irrespective of residence; Welsh and unknown LSOA residence codes are therefore retained in the practice-based totals. The residence exclusions above apply to all LSOA population comparisons; the additional missing-IMD exclusion applies only to deprivation analyses. ONS estimates cover English-resident LSOAs. In the FTE and funding sections, regional and April 2026 ICB registrations, workforce and payments follow practice assignment, while ONS populations follow residence. Aggregate registration differences do not identify individual ghost patients.

# National population over time

All population time series request data from **mid-2013**, comparing ONS mid-year estimates with available registration snapshots. The table below shows the actual coverage returned by the warehouse. An earlier requested start does not create unavailable observations; the GP-FTE series also requires workforce data in the same July.

```{r time-series-source-availability, results='asis'}
available_history <- bind_rows(
  national_time_series %>% select(Source, Period) %>% mutate(Series = "National population"),
  qualified_gp_workforce %>% filter(format(Period, "%m") == "07") %>%
    distinct(Period) %>% mutate(Source = "Practice GP workforce", Series = "July GP FTE")
)
available_history %>%
  group_by(Series, Source) %>%
  summarise(`First available snapshot` = format(min(Period), "%d %b %Y"),
    `Last available snapshot` = format(max(Period), "%d %b %Y"),
    `Available snapshots` = n_distinct(Period), .groups = "drop") %>%
  report_table(caption = "Actual source coverage for time series requested from mid-2013")
```

# Age over time

```{r age-time-series, fig.height=10}
label_chart(
ggplot(
  age_time_series,
  aes(x = Period, y = Population, colour = Sex,
      linetype = Source, group = interaction(Source, Sex))
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.numeric(as.Date("2021-07-01")),
    linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = age_time_series %>% filter(!is.na(Population)),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = age_time_series %>%
      filter(Source == "ONS population estimate", !is.na(Population)),
    size = 1.3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Age_Band, ncol = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Female = "#B2182B", Male = "#2166AC")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    "Registered patients" = "solid",
    "ONS population estimate" = "dotted"
  )) +
  scale_x_date(limits = c(start_date, end_date), breaks = history_year_breaks(2L), date_labels = "%Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10e6, by = 1e6),
    labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "m"),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 10e6)) +
  labs(
    title = "Population by age and sex over time",
    subtitle = "Ages 0–19, 20–39, 40–59 and 60+; female and male counts for each source",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Population",
    colour = "Sex", linetype = "Population source",
    caption = "Dashed line: Census 2021 year; the cause of any turning point is not established by the chart."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ),
  "Practice-level registrations"
)
```

```{r sex-time-series, fig.height=7}
label_chart(
ggplot(
  sex_time_series,
  aes(x = Period, y = Population, colour = Source, group = Source)
) +
  geom_line(
    data = sex_time_series %>% filter(!is.na(Population)),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = sex_time_series %>%
      filter(Source == "ONS population estimate", !is.na(Population)),
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Sex, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Registered patients" = "#2166AC",
    "ONS population estimate" = "#B2182B"
  )) +
  scale_x_date(limits = c(start_date, end_date), breaks = history_year_breaks(), date_labels = "%Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "m")) +
  labs(
    title = "Population by sex over time",
    subtitle = "Registered patients and ONS estimates",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Population",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ),
  "Practice-level registrations"
)
```

## IMD quintiles within each NHS England region

Each panel shows one April 2026 NHS England region. The bars compare registrations with ONS residents within the same deprivation quintile: **100 × (registered patients − ONS residents) / ONS residents**. Quintiles use national IMD deciles: 1–2 form quintile 1 (most deprived), through 9–10 forming quintile 5 (least deprived). Both sources follow residence LSOAs, with the same matched LSOAs in each bar. This snapshot comparison uses all eligible paired LSOAs at the selected date. The coverage table identifies missing source records and invalid IMD; unavailable quintiles remain gaps.

```{r region-imd-quintile-prepare, include=FALSE}
region_imd <- summarise_region_imd_quintiles(
  lsoa_registered_july %>% filter(Period == snapshot_date),
  lsoa_ons_july %>% filter(Period == snapshot_date),
  nhser_lookup, imd_lookup
)
region_imd_snapshot <- region_imd$comparison %>%
  mutate(Quintile = factor(Quintile, levels = 1:5,
    labels = c("1 (Most deprived)", "2", "3", "4", "5 (Least deprived)")))
```

```{r region-imd-quintile-chart, fig.height=11}
label_chart(
  ggplot(region_imd_snapshot, aes(Quintile, Pct_Difference)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2166AC", width = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.finite(Pct_Difference),
      sprintf("%.1f%%", Pct_Difference), NA_character_),
      vjust = ifelse(Pct_Difference >= 0, -0.35, 1.35)),
      colour = "grey20", size = 3, na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~ NHSER26NM, ncol = 2) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = c("1 (Most deprived)" = "1", "2" = "2",
      "3" = "3", "4" = "4", "5 (Least deprived)" = "5")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.18))) +
    labs(title = "Registered patients versus ONS residents by region and IMD quintile",
      subtitle = paste(format(snapshot_date, "%B %Y"),
        "| April 2026 NHS regions | Common percentage scale across panels"),
      x = "IMD quintile (1 = most deprived; 5 = least deprived)",
      y = "Difference relative to ONS (%)",
      caption = "Each bar uses the same residence LSOAs for both sources. Missing pairs and invalid IMD are excluded; zero ONS denominators have no percentage.") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()),
  "LSOA-level registrations",
  "NHS regions: ONS April 2026 LSOA lookup; IMD classification: report's fixed IMD lookup."
)
```

# Integrated Care Boards

All ICB comparisons use the new April 2026 structure while using the July 2024 data. This population chart groups both registered patients and ONS residents through the official ONS April 2026 LSOA lookup, including the Frimley boundary changes. The later workforce and funding sections instead group practice registrations, workforce and payments through the practice-to-2026-ICB mapping.

```{r icb-snapshot-chart, fig.height=12}
icb_snapshot_plot <- icb_snapshot %>%
  mutate(ICB26NM = reorder(ICB26NM, Pct_Difference))

label_chart(
comparison_bar(
  icb_snapshot_plot,
  ICB26NM,
  "Percentage difference by NHS integrated care board",
  format(snapshot_date, "%B %Y"),
  "Integrated care board"
),
  "LSOA-level registrations"
)
```

## ICB map: deciles of registration difference

The map uses the same percentage difference as the ICB bar chart: **100 × (registered patients − ONS residents) / ONS residents**, using residence-based LSOA registrations. The colours divide ICBs into ten quantile groups, from **1 (lowest difference)** to **10 (highest difference)**. Blue indicates lower differences and red indicates higher differences; colours rank ICBs and do not mark the zero point. These are deciles of this comparison, separate from IMD deprivation deciles. They describe relative differences and do not establish how many registrations are invalid. Equal values share a group, so ties can leave some groups empty; missing or undefined differences are grey. The groups are recalculated for the selected snapshot and are not fixed percentage-point bands.

```{r icb-map-prepare, include=FALSE}
if (anyDuplicated(icb_snapshot$ICB26CD)) {
  stop("Duplicate ICB snapshot codes would duplicate map areas.")
}
icb_map_classification <- classify_icb_map_deciles(icb_snapshot$Pct_Difference)
icb_map_values <- icb_snapshot %>%
  mutate(Map_Decile = icb_map_classification$decile,
         Map_Decile_Label = icb_map_classification$label)
icb_boundaries <- load_icb_map_boundaries(nhser_lookup$ICB26CD)
if (nrow(anti_join(icb_map_values, sf::st_drop_geometry(icb_boundaries),
                  by = "ICB26CD"))) {
  stop("An ICB comparison has no April 2026 map boundary.")
}
icb_map <- icb_boundaries %>%
  select(ICB26CD) %>%
  left_join(icb_map_values, by = "ICB26CD")
icb_map$Map_Decile_Label <- factor(
  ifelse(is.na(icb_map$Map_Decile_Label), "No comparable data",
         as.character(icb_map$Map_Decile_Label)),
  levels = levels(icb_map_classification$label))
icb_map_colours <- setNames(
  c("#053061", "#2166AC", "#4393C3", "#92C5DE", "#D1E5F0",
    "#FDDBC7", "#F4A582", "#D6604D", "#B2182B", "#67001F", "#BDBDBD"),
  levels(icb_map_classification$label))
```

```{r icb-decile-map, fig.width=9, fig.height=10}
label_chart(
  ggplot(icb_map) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = Map_Decile_Label), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = icb_map_colours, drop = FALSE,
                      name = "Registration difference decile") +
    coord_sf(crs = sf::st_crs(27700), datum = NA) +
    labs(title = "Registered patients versus ONS residents by ICB",
      subtitle = paste(format(snapshot_date, "%B %Y"),
        "| April 2026 ICB boundaries | Blue = lower; red = higher"),
      caption = "Deciles rank the signed percentage difference relative to ONS; they are not IMD deciles.\nBoundaries: ONS April 2026 BSC, 200 m generalisation. Contains OS and ONS data © Crown copyright.") +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "right", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(margin = margin(b = 8)),
          plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)),
  "LSOA-level registrations"
)
```

```{r icb-map-decile-key, results='asis'}
icb_map_classification$key %>%
  transmute(`Map decile` = Decile, `ICBs` = ICBs,
    `Lowest observed difference (%)` = ifelse(is.na(Minimum_Pct), "Empty group",
      scales::number(Minimum_Pct, accuracy = 0.01)),
    `Highest observed difference (%)` = ifelse(is.na(Maximum_Pct), "Empty group",
      scales::number(Maximum_Pct, accuracy = 0.01))) %>%
  report_table(caption = "ICB map deciles: observed percentage ranges and number of ICBs")
```

```{r icb-snapshot-table, results='asis'}

  arrange(desc(Pct_Difference)) %>%
  transmute(
    ICB = ICB26NM,
    `Map decile` = ifelse(is.na(Map_Decile), "No comparable data", as.character(Map_Decile)),
    `Registered patients` = scales::comma(Registered),
    `ONS population` = scales::comma(ONS),
    `Raw difference` = scales::comma(Raw_Difference),
    `Percentage difference` = sprintf("%.1f%%", Pct_Difference)
  ) %>%
  report_table(caption = "Population comparison by NHS integrated care board (LSOA-level registrations)")
```

# Patients per qualified GP FTE

```{r patients-per-gp-prepare, include=FALSE}
workforce_national_july <- qualified_gp_workforce %>%
  filter(format(Period, "%m") == "07") %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(format(Period, "%Y"))) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(GP_FTE = sum(GP_FTE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

population_national_july <- national_time_series %>%
  filter(format(Period, "%m") == "07") %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(format(Period, "%Y"))) %>%
  select(Year, Source, Population)

patients_per_gp_july <- population_national_july %>%
  inner_join(workforce_national_july, by = "Year") %>%
  mutate(
    Period = as.Date(paste0(Year, "-07-01")),
    Patients_Per_GP_FTE = Population / GP_FTE
  )

workforce_snapshot <- qualified_gp_workforce %>%
  filter(format(Period, "%Y-%m") == format(snapshot_date, "%Y-%m"))

workforce_region_snapshot <- workforce_snapshot %>%
  inner_join(practice_region_lookup, by = "Practice_Code") %>%
  group_by(NHS_Region) %>%
  summarise(GP_FTE = sum(GP_FTE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

patients_per_gp_region_snapshot <- region_snapshot %>%
  transmute(
    NHS_Region = normalise_region_name(NHSER26NM),
    NHS_Region_Display = NHSER26NM,
    ONS
  ) %>%
  full_join(practice_region_registered, by = "NHS_Region") %>%
  inner_join(workforce_region_snapshot, by = "NHS_Region") %>%
  filter(GP_FTE > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Registered_Per_GP_FTE = Registered / GP_FTE,
    ONS_Per_GP_FTE = ONS / GP_FTE,
    Pct_Difference_Per_GP_FTE =
      100 * (Registered_Per_GP_FTE - ONS_Per_GP_FTE) / ONS_Per_GP_FTE
  )

workforce_icb_snapshot <- workforce_snapshot %>%
  inner_join(practice_icb_lookup, by = "Practice_Code") %>%
  group_by(ICB_Key, ICB) %>%
  summarise(GP_FTE = sum(GP_FTE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

icb_population_snapshot <- icb_snapshot %>%
  transmute(
    ICB_Key = ICB26CD,
    ICB_Population_Name = ICB26NM,
    ONS
  )

patients_per_gp_icb_snapshot <- icb_population_snapshot %>%
  full_join(
    practice_icb_registered %>% rename(ICB_Registered_Name = ICB),
    by = "ICB_Key"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    workforce_icb_snapshot %>% rename(ICB_Workforce_Name = ICB),
    by = "ICB_Key"
  ) %>%
  filter(GP_FTE > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    ICB = coalesce(
      ICB_Population_Name,
      ICB_Registered_Name,
      ICB_Workforce_Name
    ),
    Registered_Per_GP_FTE = Registered / GP_FTE,
    ONS_Per_GP_FTE = ONS / GP_FTE
  ) %>%
  select(
    ICB_Key,
    ICB,
    Registered,
    ONS,
    GP_FTE,
    Registered_Per_GP_FTE,
    ONS_Per_GP_FTE
  )

patients_per_gp_national_snapshot <- patients_per_gp_july %>%
  filter(Year == as.integer(format(snapshot_date, "%Y"))) %>%
  select(Source, Patients_Per_GP_FTE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Source, values_from = Patients_Per_GP_FTE) %>%
  transmute(
    Geography = "England",
    Registered_Per_GP_FTE = `Registered patients`,
    ONS_Per_GP_FTE = `ONS population estimate`
  )

patients_per_gp_region_long <- patients_per_gp_region_snapshot %>%
  select(
    NHS_Region,
    `Registered patients` = Registered_Per_GP_FTE,
    `ONS population` = ONS_Per_GP_FTE
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -NHS_Region,
    names_to = "Population basis",
    values_to = "Patients_Per_GP_FTE"
  )

region_gp_order <- patients_per_gp_region_snapshot %>%
  arrange(Registered_Per_GP_FTE) %>%
  pull(NHS_Region)

patients_per_gp_region_long <- patients_per_gp_region_long %>%
  mutate(NHS_Region = factor(NHS_Region, levels = region_gp_order))

patients_per_gp_icb_long <- patients_per_gp_icb_snapshot %>%
  select(
    ICB,
    `Registered patients` = Registered_Per_GP_FTE,
    `ONS population` = ONS_Per_GP_FTE
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -ICB,
    names_to = "Population basis",
    values_to = "Patients_Per_GP_FTE"
  )

icb_gp_order <- patients_per_gp_icb_snapshot %>%
  arrange(Registered_Per_GP_FTE) %>%
  pull(ICB)

patients_per_gp_icb_long <- patients_per_gp_icb_long %>%
  mutate(ICB = factor(ICB, levels = icb_gp_order))
```

Registrations and qualified GP FTE follow practice assignment to the April 2026 geography. ONS populations follow English residence LSOAs. Regional and ICB comparisons can therefore reflect cross-boundary registration. Unassigned practice registrations are excluded from the corresponding local comparisons: `r scales::comma(registered_unassigned_region)` without a region and `r scales::comma(registered_unassigned_icb)` without an ICB.

## July 2024 national comparison

```{r patients-per-gp-july-2024-bar, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
patients_per_gp_july_2024 <- patients_per_gp_july %>%
  filter(Period == as.Date("2024-07-01"))

expected_population_sources <- c(
  "ONS population estimate", "Registered patients"
)

if (nrow(patients_per_gp_july_2024) != 2L ||
    !setequal(patients_per_gp_july_2024$Source, expected_population_sources) ||
    any(!is.finite(patients_per_gp_july_2024$GP_FTE)) ||
    any(patients_per_gp_july_2024$GP_FTE <= 0) ||
    n_distinct(patients_per_gp_july_2024$GP_FTE) != 1L ||
    any(!is.finite(patients_per_gp_july_2024$Patients_Per_GP_FTE)) ||
    any(patients_per_gp_july_2024$Patients_Per_GP_FTE < 0)) {
  stop("The July 2024 bar chart requires both population sources and one positive qualified GP FTE total.")
}

patients_per_gp_july_2024 <- patients_per_gp_july_2024 %>%
  mutate(Source = factor(Source, levels = expected_population_sources))

label_chart(
ggplot(
  patients_per_gp_july_2024,

) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(

    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "ONS population estimate" = "#B2182B",
    "Registered patients" = "#2166AC"
  )) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "ONS population estimate" = "ONS population\nestimate",
    "Registered patients" = "Registered\npatients"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    labels = scales::label_comma(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Patients per qualified GP FTE",
```

### Map of the difference

Registered patients per GP FTE minus ONS residents per GP FTE. Positive differences mean more registered patients than ONS residents per unit of the same partner-and-salaried GP FTE. The colours are ten deciles of this signed difference in people per GP FTE, rather than the two rates separately. Each map has its own decile thresholds; grey indicates unavailable inputs.

```{r patients-per-gp-icb-map-prepare, include=FALSE}

  patients_per_gp_icb_snapshot, icb_boundaries$ICB26CD,
  "Registered_Per_GP_FTE", "ONS_Per_GP_FTE",
  direction = "registered-minus-ons"
)
patients_per_gp_icb_map_values$data$Difference_Unit <- "people per GP FTE"
patients_per_gp_icb_map <- icb_boundaries %>%
  select(ICB26CD, ICB26NM) %>%
  left_join(patients_per_gp_icb_map_values$data, by = c("ICB26CD" = "ICB_Key"))
```

```{r payment-scenario-prepare, include=FALSE, results='asis'}
source("13_Model_Payment_Reduction.R")
source("20_Select_Payment_Components.R")

payment_input <- select_payment_components(finance_datasets)
payment_snapshot_date <- payment_input$snapshot_date
payment_components <- names(selected_payment_component_names)
payment_by_practice <- payment_input$rows %>%
  group_by(Practice_Code, Component) %>%
  summarise(Amount = sum(Amount), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Component, values_from = Amount, values_fill = 0)

national_payment_scenario <- payment_by_practice %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(payment_components), sum)) %>%
  mutate(Geography = "England", Registered = national_snapshot$Registered,
         ONS = national_snapshot$ONS) %>%
  add_pcn_participation(pcn_participation_rate) %>%
  model_payment_reduction()

regional_published_payments <- payment_by_practice %>%
  inner_join(practice_region_lookup, by = "Practice_Code", na_matches = "never") %>%
  group_by(NHS_Region) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(payment_components), sum), .groups = "drop")

regional_payment_scenario <- practice_region_registered %>%
  full_join(regional_published_payments, by = "NHS_Region") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(payment_components), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  left_join(
    region_snapshot %>%
      transmute(NHS_Region = normalise_region_name(NHSER26NM), ONS),
    by = "NHS_Region"
  ) %>%
  add_pcn_participation(pcn_participation_rate) %>%
  model_payment_reduction()

icb_published_payments <- payment_by_practice %>%
  inner_join(practice_icb_lookup, by = "Practice_Code", na_matches = "never") %>%
  group_by(ICB_Key) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(payment_components), sum), .groups = "drop")

icb_payment_scenario <- practice_icb_registered %>%
  rename(ICB_Registered_Name = ICB) %>%
  full_join(icb_published_payments, by = "ICB_Key") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(payment_components), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  left_join(icb_population_snapshot, by = "ICB_Key") %>%
  mutate(ICB = coalesce(ICB_Population_Name, ICB_Registered_Name)) %>%
  add_pcn_participation(pcn_participation_rate) %>%
  model_payment_reduction()

# Report unassigned published payments and the PCN amount for unassigned lists.
unassigned_payment_amount <- function(lookup, unassigned_registrations) {
  published <- payment_by_practice %>%
    anti_join(lookup, by = "Practice_Code", na_matches = "never") %>%
    select(all_of(payment_components))
  sum(as.matrix(published)) + pcn_participation_rate * unassigned_registrations
}
payment_unassigned_region <- unassigned_payment_amount(
  practice_region_lookup, registered_unassigned_region)
payment_unassigned_icb <- unassigned_payment_amount(
  practice_icb_lookup, registered_unassigned_icb)
if (abs(sum(regional_payment_scenario$Total_Payments) + payment_unassigned_region -
        national_payment_scenario$Total_Payments) > 0.01 ||
    abs(sum(icb_payment_scenario$Total_Payments) + payment_unassigned_icb -
        national_payment_scenario$Total_Payments) > 0.01) {
  stop("Selected payments and modelled PCN Participation do not reconcile to England.")
}

# The fixed-total scenario uses the published aggregate without a PCN top-up.
full_payment_by_practice <- select_total_payments(
  finance_datasets, payment_snapshot_date
) %>%
  group_by(Practice_Code) %>%
  summarise(Total_Payments = sum(Total_Payments), .groups = "drop")

national_full_payment_input <- tibble::tibble(
  Geography = "England", Total_Payments = sum(full_payment_by_practice$Total_Payments),
  Registered = national_snapshot$Registered, ONS = national_snapshot$ONS
)
regional_full_payment_input <- full_payment_by_practice %>%
  inner_join(practice_region_lookup, by = "Practice_Code", na_matches = "never") %>%
  group_by(NHS_Region) %>%
  summarise(Total_Payments = sum(Total_Payments), .groups = "drop") %>%
  full_join(practice_region_registered, by = "NHS_Region") %>%
  mutate(Total_Payments = replace_na(Total_Payments, 0)) %>%
  left_join(region_snapshot %>%
    transmute(NHS_Region = normalise_region_name(NHSER26NM), ONS),
    by = "NHS_Region")
icb_full_payment_input <- full_payment_by_practice %>%
  inner_join(practice_icb_lookup, by = "Practice_Code", na_matches = "never") %>%
  group_by(ICB_Key) %>%
  summarise(Total_Payments = sum(Total_Payments), .groups = "drop") %>%
  full_join(practice_icb_registered %>% rename(ICB_Registered_Name = ICB),
    by = "ICB_Key") %>%
  mutate(Total_Payments = replace_na(Total_Payments, 0)) %>%
  left_join(icb_population_snapshot, by = "ICB_Key") %>%
  mutate(ICB = coalesce(ICB_Population_Name, ICB_Registered_Name))
full_payment_unassigned_region <- full_payment_by_practice %>%
  anti_join(practice_region_lookup, by = "Practice_Code", na_matches = "never") %>%
  summarise(Amount = sum(Total_Payments)) %>% pull(Amount)
full_payment_unassigned_icb <- full_payment_by_practice %>%
  anti_join(practice_icb_lookup, by = "Practice_Code", na_matches = "never") %>%
  summarise(Amount = sum(Total_Payments)) %>% pull(Amount)
if (abs(sum(regional_full_payment_input$Total_Payments) + full_payment_unassigned_region -
        national_full_payment_input$Total_Payments) > 0.01 ||
    abs(sum(icb_full_payment_input$Total_Payments) + full_payment_unassigned_icb -
        national_full_payment_input$Total_Payments) > 0.01) {
  stop("Published full-payment totals do not reconcile to England.")
}
full_payment_basis <- "Total NHS Payments to General Practice Minus Deductions"
selected_payment_basis <- "Five selected payment components plus modelled PCN Participation"
national_payment_scenario$Payment_Basis <- selected_payment_basis
regional_payment_scenario$Payment_Basis <- selected_payment_basis
icb_payment_scenario$Payment_Basis <- selected_payment_basis
national_full_payment_input$Payment_Basis <- full_payment_basis
regional_full_payment_input$Payment_Basis <- full_payment_basis
icb_full_payment_input$Payment_Basis <- full_payment_basis

payment_currency <- function(x, accuracy = 1) {
  scales::dollar(x, prefix = gbp_symbol, accuracy = accuracy)
}
payment_loss_chart <- function(data, geography, title) {
  ggplot(data, aes(
    x = Potential_Reduction,
    y = reorder(.data[[geography]], Potential_Reduction)
  )) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2166AC", width = 0.65) +
    geom_text(
    colour = "grey20",
      aes(label = paste0(
        gbp_symbol, scales::number(Potential_Reduction / 1e6, accuracy = 0.1),
        "m (", sprintf("%.1f%%", Reduction_Pct), ")"
      )),
      hjust = -0.08, size = 3.1
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = gbp_symbol, scale = 1e-6, suffix = "m"),
      limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = paste("Payment snapshot:", format(payment_snapshot_date, "%d %b %Y"),
                       "| Population:", format(snapshot_date, "%B %Y")),
      x = "Modelled payment loss", y = NULL,
      caption = "Labels show modelled loss and its percentage of selected payments."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
payment_loss_per_resident_chart <- function(data, geography, title) {
  chart_data <- data %>% filter(is.finite(Loss_Per_ONS_Resident))
  ggplot(chart_data, aes(x = Loss_Per_ONS_Resident,
    y = reorder(.data[[geography]], Loss_Per_ONS_Resident))) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2166AC", width = 0.65) +
    geom_text(aes(label = payment_currency(Loss_Per_ONS_Resident, accuracy = 0.01)),
              colour = "grey20", hjust = -0.08, size = 3.1) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) payment_currency(x, accuracy = 1),
                      limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(title = title,
      subtitle = paste("Payment snapshot:", format(payment_snapshot_date, "%d %b %Y"),
                       "| ONS population:", format(snapshot_date, "%B %Y")),
      x = "Modelled annual payment loss per ONS resident", y = NULL,
      caption = "Annual modelled loss divided by ONS residents; zero-resident rates are undefined.") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(6, 25, 6, 6))
}

payment_loss_table <- function(data, geography, caption) {
  data %>%
    arrange(desc(Potential_Reduction)) %>%
    transmute(
      Geography = .data[[geography]],
      `Current (£)` = scales::comma(Total_Payments, accuracy = 1),
      `Rate (£/patient)` = scales::number(Payment_Per_Registered, accuracy = 0.01),
      `List reduction (n)` = scales::comma(Registrations_Removed),
      `Loss (£)` = scales::comma(Potential_Reduction, accuracy = 1),
      `Remaining (£)` = scales::comma(Remaining_Payments, accuracy = 1)
    ) %>%
    report_table(caption = paste(caption, "(Practice registrations; practice-level payments)"))
}
payment_loss_per_resident_table <- function(data, geography, caption) {
  data %>% arrange(desc(Loss_Per_ONS_Resident)) %>%
    transmute(Geography = .data[[geography]],
      `ONS residents` = scales::comma(ONS),
      `Practice registrations` = scales::comma(Registered),
      `Loss (£/ONS resident)` = ifelse(is.na(Loss_Per_ONS_Resident), "Not defined",
        scales::number(Loss_Per_ONS_Resident, accuracy = 0.01)),
      `Loss (£/registered patient)` = scales::number(Loss_Per_Registered_Patient,
                                                    accuracy = 0.01)) %>%
    report_table(caption = caption)
}
```

```{r fixed-total-payment-prepare, include=FALSE}
      caption = "Each geography's full published payment total stays unchanged; only the denominator changes."

fixed_payment_rate_table <- function(data, geography, caption) {
  data %>%
    arrange(desc(Payment_Per_Registered)) %>%
    transmute(

      `Total payments (£)` = scales::comma(Total_Payments, accuracy = 1),

                                scales::number(Payment_Per_ONS, accuracy = 0.01)),

      `Change (%)` = if_else(is.na(Rate_Change_Pct), "Not defined",
                             sprintf("%.2f%%", Rate_Change_Pct))
    ) %>%
    report_table(caption = paste(caption, "(Practice registrations; practice-level payments)"))
}
```

# If payment to general practice were to remain constant despite reduction in list size

This comparison keeps overall payments the same but changes the population denominator.

For each geography, **Total NHS Payments to General Practice Minus Deductions** is divided separately by practice-level registrations and ONS residents. The full published payment total is held fixed in both calculations; no custom PCN Participation top-up is added in this section. Payment snapshot: `r format(payment_snapshot_date, "%d %B %Y")`; population: `r format(snapshot_date, "%B %Y")`. Registrations and payments follow practice assignment, while ONS residents follow residence. ICBs use April 2026 geography. Published full payments without a region assignment total `r payment_currency(full_payment_unassigned_region)`, and without an ICB assignment total `r payment_currency(full_payment_unassigned_icb)`; these are excluded from the respective local comparisons. A higher payment per resident is an average under a fixed budget, not extra income.

```{r national-fixed-total-payment-chart, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
label_chart(
national_fixed_payment_rates %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Payment_Per_Registered, Payment_Per_ONS),
               names_to = "Denominator", values_to = "Average_Payment") %>%
  mutate(Denominator = factor(
    Denominator, levels = c("Payment_Per_Registered", "Payment_Per_ONS"),
    labels = c("Registered population", "ONS population")
  )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Denominator, y = Average_Payment, fill = Denominator)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = payment_currency(Average_Payment, accuracy = 0.01)),
            colour = "grey20",
            vjust = -0.5, size = 4, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Registered population" = "#2166AC", "ONS population" = "#B2182B"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) payment_currency(x, accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "National average payment with total payments unchanged",
    subtitle = paste("Payment snapshot:", format(payment_snapshot_date, "%d %b %Y"),
                     "| Population:", format(snapshot_date, "%B %Y")),
    x = "Population denominator", y = "Average annual payment per person",
    caption = "The same full published national payment total is used in both bars."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.minor = element_blank()),
  "Practice-level registrations",
  "Payments: practice-level annual payment data, Total NHS Payments to General Practice Minus Deductions; no custom PCN top-up; aggregated to the chart geography."
)
```

### Map of the difference

ONS-based payment per resident minus payment per registered patient; total payments held fixed. Positive differences mean a higher average when the same full published annual payment total is divided by ONS residents. Negative differences indicate a lower ONS-based average. The colours are ten deciles of this signed difference in GBP per person per year, rather than the two rates separately. Each map has its own decile thresholds; grey indicates unavailable inputs.

```{r icb-payment-per-capita-map-prepare, include=FALSE}
icb_payment_per_capita_map_values <- prepare_icb_difference_map(
  icb_fixed_payment_rates, icb_boundaries$ICB26CD,
  "Payment_Per_Registered", "Payment_Per_ONS",
  direction = "ons-minus-registered"
)
icb_payment_per_capita_map_values$data$Difference_Unit <- "GBP per person per year"
icb_payment_per_capita_map <- icb_boundaries %>%
  select(ICB26CD, ICB26NM) %>%
  left_join(icb_payment_per_capita_map_values$data, by = c("ICB26CD" = "ICB_Key"))
```

```{r icb-payment-per-capita-difference-map, fig.width=9, fig.height=10}
label_chart(
  ggplot(icb_payment_per_capita_map) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = Map_Decile_Label), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = icb_map_colours, drop = FALSE,
      name = "Difference decile\n(GBP per person per year)") +
    coord_sf(crs = sf::st_crs(27700), datum = NA) +
    labs(title = "Difference in average annual payment per person by ICB",
      subtitle = paste(format(snapshot_date, "%B %Y"), "| Payment snapshot:", format(payment_snapshot_date, "%d %b %Y")),
      caption = "ONS-based payment per resident minus payment per registered patient; total payments held fixed.\nPositive differences mean a higher average when the same full published annual payment total is divided by ONS residents. Negative differences indicate a lower ONS-based average.\nONS April 2026 ICB boundaries. Blue indicates lower signed differences and red indicates higher ones; identical values stay together.") +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "right", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(margin = margin(b = 8)),
          plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)),
  "Practice-level registrations",
  "Payments: practice-level annual payment data, Total NHS Payments to General Practice Minus Deductions; no custom PCN top-up; aggregated to April 2026 ICBs. Practice registrations follow practice assignment; ONS populations follow residence."
)
```

```{r icb-payment-per-capita-map-decile-key, results='asis'}
icb_payment_per_capita_map_values$key %>%
  transmute(`Map decile` = Decile, ICBs,
    `Lowest observed difference` = ifelse(is.na(Minimum_Difference), "Empty group",
      scales::number(Minimum_Difference, accuracy = 0.01)),
    `Highest observed difference` = ifelse(is.na(Maximum_Difference), "Empty group",
      scales::number(Maximum_Difference, accuracy = 0.01))) %>%
  report_table(caption = "Decile ranges in GBP per person per year")
```

```{r icb-fixed-total-payment-table, results='asis'}
                         "ICB average payments with each total held constant")
```

# If payments decreased alongside reduction in list size

This section uses **Global Sum, MPIG Correction Factor, Balance of PMS Expenditure, Out of Area in Hours Urgent Care and GP Extended Hours Access**, plus modelled **PCN Participation at £`r formatC(pcn_participation_rate, format = "f", digits = 3)` per baseline registered patient**. Recorded PCN Participation and all other payment categories are excluded from this narrowed total. It uses the same payment snapshot as the fixed-total section. Selected amounts without a region assignment total `r payment_currency(payment_unassigned_region)`; without an ICB assignment they total `r payment_currency(payment_unassigned_icb)`.

```{r payment-component-summary, results='asis'}
data.frame(
  Component = c(unname(selected_payment_component_names),
    "PCN Participation (modelled)", "Selected payment total"),
  Annual_Payment = c(
    unlist(national_payment_scenario[payment_components], use.names = FALSE),
    national_payment_scenario$PCN_Participation,
    national_payment_scenario$Total_Payments
  )
) %>%
  transmute(Component, `England annual amount` = payment_currency(Annual_Payment)) %>%
  report_table(caption = "Selected payment components used only in the England loss scenario")
```

This section examines how much money could be removed from practices if registered lists were reduced to be in line with the ONS. It uses the calculated payment per capita before removal and multiplies it by the removed number of patients, using the same five payment components and the modelled PCN Participation addition.

For each geography, the rate is total annual payments divided by practice-level registrations; the list reduction is the positive difference between those registrations and ONS residents. The loss is the rate multiplied by that reduction, and remaining payments are current payments minus the loss. For example, £165 per patient multiplied by 1,000 removed registrations gives a £165,000 loss. Where ONS residents equal or exceed registrations, the loss is zero. Each geography uses its own rate, so local losses need not sum to the national estimate. This is an illustrative proportional-payment scenario, not a prediction of contractual losses. The additional regional and ICB charts divide each geography's modelled annual loss by its July 2024 ONS resident population. This expresses loss per person and adjusts for population size; it does not measure density per square kilometre. The tables show both population denominators and loss per ONS resident and per registered patient. Zero ONS populations produce an undefined per-resident rate rather than zero.

```{r national-payment-loss-chart, fig.height=3.5}
label_chart(
payment_loss_chart(national_payment_scenario, "Geography", "Potential national payment loss"),
  "Practice-level registrations",
  "Payments: selected practice-level annual payment components plus modelled PCN Participation; aggregated to the chart geography."
)
```


### ICB map of potential annual payment loss per resident

This map divides each ICB's potential annual loss by its ONS resident population. It uses the narrowed five-component payment total plus the modelled PCN Participation addition. It uses ten decile colours: blue for lower loss per resident, red for higher loss per resident, and grey where a rate is unavailable. The CSV includes the selected baseline payments, annual loss, percentage loss, both populations and loss per person.

```{r icb-payment-loss-map-prepare, include=FALSE}
icb_loss_map <- icb_boundaries %>%
  select(ICB26CD, ICB26NM) %>%
  left_join(icb_payment_scenario, by = c("ICB26CD" = "ICB_Key"))
icb_loss_map_classification <- classify_icb_map_deciles(icb_loss_map$Loss_Per_ONS_Resident)
icb_loss_map$Map_Decile <- icb_loss_map_classification$decile
icb_loss_map$Map_Decile_Label <- icb_loss_map_classification$label
icb_loss_map$Map_Measure <- "Potential annual loss divided by ONS residents"
icb_loss_map$Map_Unit <- "GBP per ONS resident per year"
```

```{r icb-payment-loss-per-resident-map, fig.width=9, fig.height=10}
label_chart(
  ggplot(icb_loss_map) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = Map_Decile_Label), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = icb_map_colours, drop = FALSE,
      name = "Loss per resident decile\n(GBP per person per year)") +
    coord_sf(crs = sf::st_crs(27700), datum = NA) +
    labs(title = "Potential annual payment loss per ONS resident by ICB",
      subtitle = paste(format(snapshot_date, "%B %Y"), "| Payment snapshot:",
        format(payment_snapshot_date, "%d %b %Y")),
      caption = "Five selected payment components plus modelled PCN Participation.\nAnnual modelled loss divided by ONS residents; this is an illustrative scenario.\nONS April 2026 boundaries. Blue indicates lower loss per resident and red higher loss; ties stay together.") +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "right", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(margin = margin(b = 8)),
          plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)),
  "Practice-level registrations",
  "Payments: selected practice-level annual payment components plus modelled PCN Participation. Per-person denominator: ONS residents."
)
```

```{r icb-payment-loss-map-decile-key, results='asis'}
icb_loss_map_classification$key %>%
  transmute(`Map decile` = Decile, ICBs,
    `Lowest annual loss per ONS resident` = ifelse(is.na(Minimum_Pct), "Empty group",
      scales::number(Minimum_Pct, accuracy = 0.01)),
    `Highest annual loss per ONS resident` = ifelse(is.na(Maximum_Pct), "Empty group",
      scales::number(Maximum_Pct, accuracy = 0.01))) %>%
  report_table(caption = "Potential payment loss map deciles (GBP per ONS resident per year)")
```

```{r icb-payment-loss-per-resident-table, results='asis'}
  "Population denominators and annual modelled loss per person")
```

# Chart data files

Every chart's underlying data are saved as an unrounded CSV in `r params$chart_data_dir` when this report renders. Filenames match the chart identifiers. Map CSVs contain ICB codes, the plotted measure, decile and raw inputs; rate-difference maps also retain both source rates. Geometry is omitted. Dates use ISO format and unavailable values are blank. A manifest links each CSV to its chart and records sources and row counts. The fixed-total payment map uses the full published total; the payment-loss map uses the narrowed components plus modelled PCN Participation.

```{r chart-data-manifest, include=FALSE}
chart_csv$finish(c(
  "national-population-time-series",

  "patients-per-gp-july-2024-bar",
  "patients-per-gp-july-time-series",
  "patients-per-gp-region-dumbbell",
  "patients-per-gp-icb-dumbbell",
  "patients-per-gp-icb-difference-map",
  "national-fixed-total-payment-chart",
  "regional-fixed-total-payment-chart",
  "icb-fixed-total-payment-chart",
  "icb-payment-per-capita-difference-map",
  "national-payment-loss-chart",
  "regional-payment-loss-chart",
```
